items.title: Announcing Rust 1.98.1
items.blurb: The Rust team has published a new point release of Rust, 1.98.1. Rust is a programming language that is empowering everyone to build reliable and efficient software.

items.title: Rust SIMD on the GPU
items.blurb: GPU code can now use Rust's portable SIMD. We share the implementation approach and what this unlocks for GPU programming.

items.title: Visualizing Rust's Vtables: How dyn Trait Works In Memory
items.blurb: A follow-along series of coding experiments as I explore Rust's peculiarities, from a C++ developer's perspective.
